funding.provider: South Dakota Department of Labor and Regulation

funding.how_to_apply: Contact your Job Service office or request services online (per page).

funding.name: Build Dakota Scholarship
funding.provider: South Dakota Board of Regents / technical colleges
funding.provides: Scholarship that makes a technical degree free for students entering high-demand programs at South Dakota's four technical colleges.
funding.eligibility: Enter a high-demand program at one of four South Dakota technical colleges (Lake Area, Mitchell, Southeast, Western Dakota Tech).
funding.amount: 100% free tuition for the technical degree (per page)
funding.how_to_apply: Apply to the technical college, then complete the Build Dakota application for that school. Next window January 1 to March 31, 2027 (per page).
